# LIPINSKI Sound in Miami

> LIPINSKI Sound builds reference loudspeakers used by mastering studios. During Miami Art Week 2026 (November 30 to December 6, the week of Art Basel Miami Beach), its speakers can be heard by complimentary private demo at CasaHiFi, 2610 S Dixie Hwy, Miami, FL 33133. LIPINSKI Sound is independent and is not affiliated with Art Basel.

## Key facts

- Where: CasaHiFi, 2610 S Dixie Hwy, Miami, FL 33133 (Coconut Grove). CasaHiFi phone: +1 (786) 618-5990.
- When: demos run through Miami Art Week, November 30 to December 6, 2026, and continue afterwards. The fair's public days are December 4 to 6.
- On demonstration: the L-50 reference monitor, the L-700SE Grand and the L-700SE Powered Signature.
- LIPINSKI Sound is not exhibiting at the Art Basel fair. The demos are at CasaHiFi, by appointment.
- Book a demo: https://calendly.com/lukas-lipinskisound/30min
- Cost: the demo is complimentary. About a dozen private sessions are available during Art Week.
- Contact: Lukas Lipinski, getinfo@lipinskisound.com, +1 (917) 209-9269.

## Products

- L-50: two-way active reference monitor, the only Class A active monitor in production. 45 Hz to 40 kHz. LIPINSKI Square amplifier with no integrated circuits in the signal path. The amplifier is built in, so no separate amplifier is needed. Finishes: Obsidian Black or Arctic White. Offered during Art Week as a turnkey, full-frequency system for $12,800. With the subwoofer, the system covers 24 Hz to 40 kHz.
- L-700SE: Class A active monitor. $17,500 each.
- L-700SE Grand: Class A active floor-standing loudspeaker. $34,000 each.
- L-700SE Powered Signature: Class A active flagship. From $50,000 each.

## Buying

- Florida orders go through CasaHiFi, the Florida dealer for LIPINSKI Sound.
- Elsewhere in the continental United States: reserve the L-50 turnkey system online for $12,800: a pair of L-50s, a Proficient Reference FRS 10-inch powered subwoofer (1,000 watts, down to 24 Hz) and a WiiM Ultra streamer with cabling. It comes with a 30-day private audition, complimentary insured delivery and a full refund on return.

## About the company

- Founded in 2003 in Bethesda, Maryland, by recording engineer Dr. Andrew Lipinski. Led today by his son, Lukas Lipinski.
- Used by Universal Mastering, Mobile Fidelity, Avatar Studios in New York, NYU Steinhardt and "The President's Own" U.S. Marine Band.
- Stereophile placed the L-707 in Class A of its Recommended Components.

- This summary was last updated on November 18, 2026.
